**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 13 (Access Rights and Licence) satisfies every preferred element of the LICENSE rule:

- **Affiliates & contractors** — §13.1 grants access "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with no written-notice gating (so the fallback's notice mechanic is unnecessary), and §13.2 extends the paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates including contractor support.
- **Paid-up perpetual / irrevocable** — §13.2 is "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid," and §14.3 confirms it reaches Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables.
- **Subscription revocation** — §13.3 bars Vendor from revoking or suspending except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and cure; this is narrower than the preferred standard and therefore favourable to us.
- **Successor transfer** — §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under §24.1, which allows consent-free assignment to an M&A successor, and §24.4 blocks Vendor repricing or termination on our change of control.

No narrowing "Authorized User" or site definition exists in §1, and the §13.4 use restrictions are ordinary conduct limits that expressly preserve Customer Data and output use. Nothing here warrants a redline.
